name: Cursed Umbral Tin
tooltip:
Cursed Umbral Tin
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
Umbral Tin is distinguished from its less impressive cousin by the deep shade of the ore. It resembles the inky black sky. Umbral Tin is more durable yet also more flexible than most other metals.

This deposit writhes with Ula'tek's curse. Standing near it makes the air feel heavier, as if drenched in the rage of every soul sacrificed on the altar of hubris.
